description: This file defines a template class 'RecorderType' for recording and managing time-stamped measurements with delta compression. It includes nested classes for reading and writing measurement data to files, with mechanisms for serialization, deserialization, and delta encoding. The file also contains detailed comments explaining the data format and storage structure.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::RecorderType
classes.description: A template class for recording time-stamped measurements with delta compression, supporting file-based persistence with nested Reader and Writer classes.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::RecorderType::BaseRecorder
classes.description: An internal base class managing core recording state, buffer management, and serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::RecorderType::Writer
classes.description: A class for recording measurements and writing them to files, handling file rotation and delta encoding.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::RecorderType::Reader
classes.description: A class for reading and iterating over recorded measurement data from files.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a measurement value with timestamp, updating internal delta encoding.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances the internal pointer to the next measurement, updating time and value based on stored deltas.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Moves the internal pointer to the previous measurement, reversing delta updates.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current recording state into another recorder instance.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads measurement data from a file into the recorder, reconstructing the measurement sequence.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Serializes the current measurement data to a file.

methods.name: ClearData
methods.description: Resets the internal data to initial state.

methods.name: StoreDelta
methods.description: Encodes a delta value into the storage buffer using variable-length encoding.

methods.name: ForwardElement
methods.description: Decodes the next delta element from the storage buffer.

methods.name: BackwardElement
methods.description: Decodes the previous delta element from the storage buffer.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Writer instance for a given filename.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a new measurement value with current timestamp.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the reader to a specific measurement ID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the reader to the next measurement.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the reader to the previous measurement.
